[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Fresh Fruit Salad: Cut up a variety of fruits like apples, bananas, grapes, and berries, and store them in an airtight container.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Carrot and Celery Sticks with Hummus: Dip raw or roasted veggies in a protein-rich hummus for a satisfying crunch.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Trail Mix: Mix nuts, seeds, and dried fruits for a healthy and convenient snack.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Hard-Boiled Eggs: Boil a dozen eggs and keep them in the fridge for up to a week.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Greek Yogurt Parfait: Layer Greek yogurt, fresh berries, and granola for a protein-rich snack.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Energy Balls: Mix rolled oats, nuts, and dried fruits to create bite-sized energy balls.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Whole Grain Crackers with Avocado or Peanut Butter: Spread whole grain crackers with mashed avocado or peanut butter for healthy fats.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Oat and Nut Bites: Mix rolled oats, nuts, and seeds to create bite-sized energy bites.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Whole Grain Granola Bars: Make your own granola bars with rolled oats, nuts, and dried fruits.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Roasted Chickpeas: Roast chickpeas with herbs and spices for a crunchy snack.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 11. Spinach and Feta Stuffed Mushrooms: Fill mushroom caps with sautéed spinach, feta cheese, and whole grain breadcrumbs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 12. Cucumber Slices with Guacamole: Dip cucumber slices in guacamole for a refreshing snack.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 13. Edamame: Steam or boil edamame for a protein-rich snack.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 14. Smoothie Packs: Prep individual smoothie packs with frozen fruits, spinach, and protein powder for a quick snack.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 15. Infused Water: Infuse water with fruits, cucumbers, or mint leaves for a refreshing beverage.
